1 """campaign_page — the Campaign, version D: John's initiatives in three priority tiers, and the same record
2 against the five-week ruler behind one button.
3 
4 W3c of the High Seat plan (2026-09-26). The approved design is the mockup
5 ``Skill Foundry/planning/high-seat-2026-09-24/ideation/mockups/campaign/campaign-D.html``; its stylesheet is
6 ``static/campaign-page.css`` ported as it is. This module renders that page from the Campaign record —
7 the initiatives (heading steps with tier, area, outcome, their root group's order), their parts (steps whose
8 path starts with the initiative; a ``ref`` part read through the resolver), the strip's seeds — plus the
9 steward livery and the effort's own conversation. Pure: a context dict in, HTML out. Every count on the
10 page is counted from the record. The acts on the page go through ``steward_cockpit/campaign_acts``.
11 """

37 def _part_state(p):
38     # W1 (2026-09-28): a referenced part's done/closed comes from the RESOLVED target too (campaign_initiatives'
39     # `done` / `closed` flags), never the wrapper's status alone
40     if p["broken"]:
41         return "broken reference"
42     if p.get("done", p["status"] == "done"):
43         return "done"
44     if p["status"] == "parked" or p.get("target_status") == "parked":
45         return "parked"
46     if p["needs_you"]:
47         return "needs you"
48     return p["state"] or p["status"] or "open"

76             if not ref else (('<a class="tickpad%s" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="done or parked in its own record &mdash; open it"></a>' % (" on" if done else "", esc(p["href"])))

86 def _part_light(p, working):
87     """A project part's own light: needs him · working (a live session on it) · waiting · done · idle."""
88     if p.get("done"):
89         return "done"
90     if p.get("needs_you"):
91         return "needs"
92     if p.get("pid") and p["pid"] in (working or set()):
93         return "working"
94     if str(p.get("state") or "").lower().startswith("waiting") or p.get("status") == "waiting":
95         return "waiting"
96     return "idle"

99 def _cockpits(i, ctx):
100     """The goal's cockpits on the tile's face (his 13:5x word: a goal holds one, several, or no project yet): each
101     project part by name with its own light; "at the desk" when the goal has no project."""
102     working = ctx.get("working") or set()
103     projs = [p for p in i["parts"] if p["kind"] in ("project", "effort") and not p["broken"]]
104     if not projs:

106     glyphs = {"needs": "&#9873;", "working": "&#9679;", "waiting": "&#9679;", "idle": "&#9675;", "done": "&#10003;"}
107     return '<div class="gcock">%s</div>' % " &middot; ".join(
108         '<span class="gpc %s" title="%s">%s <i>%s</i>%s</span>' % (_part_light(p, working), esc(p["state"] or p["status"] or ""), esc(p["target"] or p["text"]), glyphs[_part_light(p, working)],
109                                                                     ('<b class="seat %s">%s</b>' % (p["seat"], "active" if p["seat"] == "active" else "on deck")) if p.get("seat") else "")
110         for p in projs[:4]) + ((' <span class="dim">+%d</span>' % (len(projs) - 4)) if len(projs) > 4 else "")

113 def _gtile(i, ctx, band, draggable=True):
114     """One goal on the board (W2 v2, his lock of 11:0x): its number, its name (opens its place), its tier and light,
115     the goal in a line, its cockpits with their lights (or "at the desk"), and the facts — progress, pace, next
116     deadline, what waits on him. It drags."""
117     today = ctx["today"]
118     glyph, word = LIGHTS[initiative_light(i, ctx.get("working") or set())]
119     n, done = len(i["parts"]), int(i.get("done_count") or 0)
120     pct = int(round(100.0 * done / n)) if n else 0
121     nd = i.get("next_deadline") or ""
122     nd_d = _hr._iso(nd) if nd else None
123     dcls = ("over" if nd_d and nd_d < today else ("soon" if nd_d and (nd_d - today).days <= 7 else ""))
124     return (
125         '<article class="gtile%s%s" draggable="%s" data-lane="%s" data-band="%s" style="--areac:%s">'
126         '<div class="ihead"><button class="iname" data-open="%s" title="open its place">%s</button>'
127         '<span class="gtier">tier %s</span><span class="ilight %s" title="the light: needs you · working · waiting · idle, read from its parts">%s %s</span></div>'
128         '<div class="ggoal" title="%s">%s</div>%s%s'
129         '<div class="gfacts"><span class="gprog"><span class="bar"><i style="width:%d%%"></i></span>%d of %d</span><span class="%s">%s</span><span class="gdl %s">%s</span>%s</div></article>'
130     ) % (" needs" if i["needs"] else "", " bone" if i["status"] in ("done", "parked") else "", "true" if draggable else "false", esc(i["id"]), band, AREA_COLOURS.get(i["area"], "#8b93a6"),
131          esc(i["id"]), esc(i["name"]), i["tier"] or "?",
132          initiative_light(i, ctx.get("working") or set()), glyph, word,
133          esc(i["done_when"]), esc(i["done_when"]) or '<span class="dim">no goal written yet</span>',
134          _cockpits(i, ctx), _ifthen(i) + _premortem(i, ctx),
135          pct, done, n, "" if i.get("pace") else "dim", ("pace " + esc(_short(i["pace"]))) if i.get("pace") else "no pace",
136          dcls, (("overdue " if dcls == "over" else "next ") + esc(_short(nd))) if nd else "no deadline",
137          (' <span class="am">&#9873; %s</span>' % _needs(len(i["needs"]))) if i["needs"] else "")

170 def _band(key, label, note, items, ctx, cls="", extra="", quiet_empty=False):
171     tiles = "".join(_gtile(i, ctx, key) for i in items)
172     empty = {"1": "nothing in tier 1", "2": "nothing in tier 2", "3": "no seed goal yet"}.get(key, "nothing here")
173     return ('<section class="band%s" data-band="%s"><h4 class="band-h">%s <span class="c">%s</span></h4>'
174             '<div class="tiles">%s</div>%s</section>' % ((" " + cls) if cls else "", key, label, note,
175                                                        tiles or ("" if quiet_empty else '<div class="empty">%s</div>' % empty), extra))

178 def _bands(ctx):
179     """The goal board (PLAN v1.3): Tier 1 · Tier 2 · Seed goals (the tier-3 and untiered goals, and the seeds) · the
180     Boneyard (done or parked goals, folded, never deleted). No Active band: seats live at the High Seat. No order
181     inside a tier (his word, 09-29 18:4x)."""
182     inits = ctx["initiatives"]
183     live = [i for i in inits if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
184     bone = [i for i in inits if i["status"] in ("done", "parked")]
185     out = []
186     for t in (1, 2):
187         mine = [i for i in live if i["tier"] == t]
188         needs = sum(1 for i in mine if i["needs"])
189         out.append(_band(str(t), "Tier %d" % t, "%s &middot; %d goal%s%s" % (TIER_WORDS[t], len(mine), "" if len(mine) == 1 else "s",
190                          (' &middot; <span class="am">%s</span>' % _needs(needs, "goal")) if needs else ""), mine, ctx))
191     seedy = [i for i in live if i["tier"] not in (1, 2)]
192     out.append(_band("3", "Seed goals", "for the future &middot; a tier-3 goal sits here until you say tier 2; a goal with no tier yet is marked tier ? until you pick one; a seed becomes a goal on its card", seedy, ctx, "seeds", extra=_seedband(ctx), quiet_empty=bool(ctx.get("seeds"))))
193     out.append('<section class="band bone" data-band="bone"><h4 class="band-h">The boneyard <span class="c">done or abandoned goals &mdash; folded, never deleted</span><button class="mini" id="boneTog" aria-expanded="false">show (%d)</button></h4>'
194                '<div class="bonefold" id="boneFold" hidden>%s</div></section>' % (len(bone), "".join(_gtile(i, ctx, "bone", draggable=False) for i in bone) or '<div class="empty">nothing here yet &mdash; a goal marked done or abandoned lands here</div>'))
195     return '<div class="bands" id="viewGrouped">%s</div>' % "".join(out)

287         '<div class="comp-row"><span class="hint">Ctrl+Enter sends &middot; inside this goal nothing needs its name &middot; the steward answers here as it writes</span><button class="send gsend" data-goal="%s">Send</button></div>'

289         '</div></div></article>'
290     ) % (esc(i["id"]), esc(i["id"]), AREA_COLOURS.get(i["area"], "#8b93a6"), esc(i["name"]),
291          initiative_light(i, ctx.get("working") or set()), glyph, word, esc(i["area"].title() or "no area"), esc(i["id"]), tier_opts,

309 def _calendar(ctx):
310     today = ctx["today"]
311     weeks = ruler_weeks(today)
312     inits = ctx["initiatives"]
313     monday = weeks[0]["start"]
314 
315     # cells: 0 = no date (undated, and parked — a parked part is never on the ruler); 7 = before this week (a past
316     # date: overdue while open, done with its date otherwise); 1–5 = the weeks; 6 = beyond the ruler
317     def bucket(p):
318         d = _hr._iso(p["date"]) if p["date"] else None
319         if d is None or p["status"] == "parked":
320             return 0
321         if d < monday:
322             return 7
323         for k, w in enumerate(weeks):
324             if w["start"] <= d <= w["end"]:
325                 return k + 1
326         return 6
327     counts = [0] * 8
328     overdue = parked_dated = 0
329     for i in [x for x in inits if x["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]:
330         for p in i["parts"]:
331             b = bucket(p)
332             counts[b] += 1
333             if b == 7 and p["status"] != "done" and not p["broken"]:
334                 overdue += 1
335             if b == 0 and p["date"] and p["status"] == "parked":
336                 parked_dated += 1
337     has_over = counts[7] > 0
338     order = [0] + ([7] if has_over else []) + [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
339     head = ['<div class=" nod"><b>No date</b><span class="sm">undated and parked parts</span><span class="cn">%d undated%s</span></div>' % (
340         counts[0] - parked_dated, (" &middot; %d parked" % parked_dated) if parked_dated else "")]
341     if has_over:
342         head.append('<div class=" over"><b>Before this week</b><span class="sm">past dates</span><span class="cn">%s</span></div>' % (
343             ("%d overdue" % overdue) if overdue else ("%d done" % counts[7])))
344     for k, w in enumerate(weeks):
345         head.append('<div class="%s"><b>%s</b><span class="sm">%s</span><span class="cn">%s</span></div>' % (
346             "now" if k == 0 else "", esc(w["label"]), esc(w["name"]), ("%d dated" % counts[k + 1]) if counts[k + 1] else "nothing dated"))
347     head.append('<div class=" beyond"><b>%s &rarr;</b><span class="sm">beyond the ruler</span><span class="cn">%s</span></div>' % (
348         esc(_hr.short_date((weeks[-1]["end"] + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat())), ("%d dated" % counts[6]) if counts[6] else "nothing dated"))
349 
350     def chip(i, p, past):
351         pdone = bool(p.get("done", p["status"] == "done"))
352         pclosed = bool(p.get("closed", p["status"] in ("done", "parked")))
353         late = past and not pclosed and not p["broken"]
354         cls = " need" if p["needs_you"] else (" done" if pdone else (" over" if late else ""))
355         tail = ('<span class="pc-f">&#9873; needs you</span>' if p["needs_you"] else
356                 ('<span class="pc-s ok">&#10003; done</span>' if pdone else
357                  ('<span class="pc-f">overdue</span>' if late else ('<span class="pc-c">parked</span>' if (pclosed and not pdone) else ""))))
358         return ('<button class="pc%s" data-act="chip" data-lane="%s" data-part="%s"><span class="pc-top"><span class="pc-d">%s</span><span class="pc-k">%s</span></span>'
359                 '<span class="pc-n">%s</span>%s</button>' % (cls, esc(i["id"]), esc(p["id"]), esc(_short(p["date"])) if p["date"] else "no date", esc(p["kind"]), esc(p["text"]), tail))
360 
361     def cell_class(k):
362         return " now" if k == 1 else (" beyond" if k == 6 else (" over" if k == 7 else ""))
363 
364     def lane(i):
365         cells = [[] for _ in range(8)]
366         for p in i["parts"]:
367             b = bucket(p)
368             cells[b].append(chip(i, p, b == 7))
369         track = "".join('<div class="cell%s">%s</div>' % (cell_class(k), "".join(cells[k])) for k in order)
370         return (
371             '<section class="lane" data-lane="%s" style="--areac:%s"><div class="lane-h">'
372             '<button class="lane-t" data-act="toggle" data-lane="%s"><span class="lrow1"><span class="ln">%s</span><span class="larea" style="--areac:%s">%s</span></span>'
373             '<span class="ldone"><span class="k">Done looks like</span>%s</span></button><span class="lmeta">%s%d parts &middot; %d dated</span></div>'
374             '<div class="track">%s</div></section>' % (
375                 esc(i["id"]), AREA_COLOURS.get(i["area"], "#8b93a6"), esc(i["id"]), esc(i["name"]), AREA_COLOURS.get(i["area"], "#8b93a6"),
376                 esc(i["area"].title() or "no area"), esc(i["done_when"]) or "not written yet",
377                 ('<span class="fl">%s</span>' % _needs(len(i["needs"]))) if i["needs"] else "",
378                 len(i["parts"]), sum(1 for p in i["parts"] if p["date"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked") and not p["broken"]), track))
379 
380     def strip(label, word, colour, mine):
381         needs = sum(1 for i in mine if i["needs"])
382         dated = sum(1 for i in mine for p in i["parts"] if p["date"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked") and not p["broken"])
383         return '<div class="tierstrip" style="--tierc:%s"><span class="tn">%s</span><span class="tw">%s</span><span class="tm">%d goal%s &middot; %s &middot; %d dated part%s</span></div>' % (
384             colour, label, word, len(mine), "" if len(mine) == 1 else "s", ('<span class="am">%s</span>' % _needs(needs, "goal")) if needs else "no goal needs you", dated, "" if dated == 1 else "s")
385     # the board's buckets (Grok, the W2 trim): the live tier 1, the live tier 2, the seed goals; done and parked goals stay out
386     lanes = []
387     live = [i for i in inits if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
388     for t in (1, 2):
389         mine = [i for i in live if i["tier"] == t]
390         lanes.append(strip("Tier %d" % t, TIER_WORDS[t], TIER_COLOURS[t], mine))
391         lanes.extend(lane(i) for i in mine)
392     seedy = [i for i in live if i["tier"] not in (1, 2)]
393     lanes.append(strip("Seed goals", "for the future", TIER_COLOURS[3], seedy))
394     lanes.extend(lane(i) for i in seedy)
395     return '<div class="scroll%s" id="viewCal" style="flex:1;display:none"><div id="boardScroll"><div class="rl-head">%s</div>%s</div></div>' % (
396         " has-over" if has_over else "", "".join(head), "".join(lanes))
397

401 def _seedband(ctx):
402     """The seeds as a tile (John, 2026-09-27): closed by default with the count in its head; the head toggles it open to
403     the seed row as it was — each seed with Make it an initiative and its two questions on the card."""

405     if not seeds:
406         row = '<div class="seed"><div class="st dim">No seeds yet.</div><div class="sw">Tell the steward &ldquo;seed: &hellip;&rdquo; on the home, or in the cockpit&rsquo;s grasscatcher.</div></div>'
407     else:
408         tiers = "".join('<button data-picktier="%d"%s>Tier %d%s</button>' % (t, ' class="on"' if t == 3 else "", t, " &middot; suggested" if t == 3 else "") for t in (1, 2, 3))
409         areas = "".join('<button data-pickarea="%s">%s</button>' % (a, a.title()) for a in AREAS) + '<button data-pickarea="" class="on">none yet</button>'
410         row = "".join('<div class="seed" data-seed="%s"><div class="st">%s</div><div class="sw">would suit <b>tier 3</b> &mdash; you choose the tier and the life area</div>'
411                       '<button class="mk" data-act="promote" data-seed="%s">Make it a goal</button>'
412                       '<div class="pick" hidden><div class="q">Which tier?</div><div class="prow">%s</div><div class="q">Which life area?</div><div class="prow">%s</div>'
413                       '<div class="prow"><button class="go" data-pickgo="%s">Create it in tier 3</button><button class="cancel" data-pickcancel="1">cancel</button></div></div></div>'
414                       % (esc(s["id"]), esc(s["text"]), esc(s["id"]), tiers, areas, esc(s["id"])) for s in seeds)
415     return ('<section class="seedband" id="seedband" aria-label="Seeds"><button class="sb-h" id="seedToggle" aria-expanded="false"><span class="t">Seeds</span>'
416             '<span class="c" id="seedCount"><b>%d</b> idea%s, not yet goals</span>'
417             '<span class="note">Making one a goal asks for its tier and its life area on the card &mdash; nothing is created until Create it.</span>'
418             '<span class="tog" id="seedTog">Show</span></button><div class="seedrow" id="seedRow">%s</div></section>'
419             % (len(seeds), "" if len(seeds) == 1 else "s", row))

433 def brief_bullets(ctx):
434     inits = [i for i in ctx["initiatives"] if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]      # the board's live goals (Grok, the W2 trim)
435     today = ctx["today"]
436     out = []
437     t1 = [i for i in inits if i["tier"] == 1]
438     dated = sorted(((p["date"], p, i) for i in inits for p in i["parts"] if p["date"] and not p["broken"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked")), key=lambda x: x[0])
439     ahead = next(((d, p, i) for d, p, i in dated if _hr._iso(d) and _hr._iso(d) >= today), None)
440     if t1:
441         out.append("<b>Tier 1</b> holds %s.%s" % (" &middot; ".join(esc(i["name"]) for i in t1),
442                    (" The nearest hard date is <b>%s</b>, on <b>%s</b> in %s (tier %d)." % (esc(_short(ahead[0])), esc(ahead[1]["text"]), esc(ahead[2]["name"]), ahead[2]["tier"])) if ahead else " Nothing in the Campaign carries a date yet."))
443     else:
444         out.append("No Tier 1 goal yet &mdash; give one a tier.")
445     mon = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday()); sun = mon + timedelta(days=6)
446     week = [(d, p, i) for d, p, i in dated if _hr._iso(d) and mon <= _hr._iso(d) <= sun]
447     if week:
448         out.append("This week, %s: %s." % (esc(_hr.week_in_words(today).replace("this week ", "")), "; ".join("%s (%s, %s)" % (esc(p["text"]), esc(_short(d)), esc(i["name"])) for d, p, i in week[:3])))
449     else:
450         out.append("This week, %s: <b>nothing in the Campaign is dated inside it</b>.%s" % (
451             esc(_hr.week_in_words(today).replace("this week ", "")), (" The first mark is %s." % esc(_short(ahead[0]))) if ahead else ""))
452     needs = [(p, i) for i in inits for p in i["needs"]]
453     if needs:
454         out.append('<span class="amberword">&#9873; %d part%s need%s you</span>, %d with no date. In tier order: %s%s.' % (
455             len(needs), "" if len(needs) == 1 else "s", "s" if len(needs) == 1 else "", sum(1 for p, i in needs if not p["date"]),
456             " &middot; ".join('<button class="goto" data-goto="%s">%s</button> (tier %s)' % (esc(i["id"]), esc(p["text"]), i["tier"] or "?") for p, i in needs[:3]),
457             (" &hellip; and %d more" % (len(needs) - 3)) if len(needs) > 3 else ""))
458     else:
459         out.append("Nothing in the Campaign waits on your word.")
460     counts = {a: sum(1 for i in inits if i["area"] == a) for a in AREAS}
461     out.append("Across your life: %s. <span class=\"n\">%d</span> seed%s sit%s in Seed goals." % (
462         " &middot; ".join("%s <span class=\"n\">%d</span>" % (a.title(), counts[a]) for a in AREAS if counts[a]) or "no areas yet",
463         len(ctx.get("seeds") or []), "" if len(ctx.get("seeds") or []) == 1 else "s", "s" if len(ctx.get("seeds") or []) == 1 else ""))
464     return out

467 def look_ahead(ctx):
468     """The look-ahead (the Star Chart, 2026-10-03; it took the brief's place): what is coming up in the next seven days,
469     the Tier-1/2 goals behind their pace, the goals starving (each with Open · Not now · Park), and one preparation -
470     all read from the record. A dated item within three days is named here only; its alert is the Cave's interrupt lane."""
471     inits = [i for i in ctx["initiatives"] if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
472     today = ctx["today"]
473     dated = sorted(((_hr._iso(p["date"]), p, i) for i in inits for p in i["parts"]
474                     if p["date"] and not p["broken"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked") and _hr._iso(p["date"])), key=lambda x: x[0])
475     soon = [(d, p, i) for d, p, i in dated if today <= d <= today + timedelta(days=7)]
476     items = []
477     if soon:
478         items.append('<li><b>Coming up:</b> %s.</li>' % " &middot; ".join(
479             '%s %s (%s)%s' % (esc(_short(d.isoformat())), esc(p["text"][:60]), esc(i["name"]),
480                               ' <span class="dim">its alert is on the %s</span>' % esc(ctx["steward"]["high_seat_name"]) if (d - today).days <= 3 else "")
481             for d, p, i in soon[:4]))
482     else:
483         nxt = next(((d, p, i) for d, p, i in dated if d >= today), None)
484         items.append('<li><b>Coming up:</b> nothing dated in the next seven days%s.</li>' % (
485             (" &middot; the first is %s, %s (%s)" % (esc(_short(nxt[0].isoformat())), esc(nxt[1]["text"][:60]), esc(nxt[2]["name"]))) if nxt else ""))
486     behind = []
487     for i in inits:
488         if i["tier"] not in (1, 2):
489             continue
490         pace = _hr._iso(i.get("pace") or "")
491         n = int(i.get("part_count") or 0); done = int(i.get("done_count") or 0)
492         if not pace:
493             if i["tier"] == 1:
494                 behind.append('%s has no pace set' % esc(i["name"]))
495             continue
496         if pace < today and done < n:
497             behind.append('%s is past its pace (%s) with %d of %d parts done' % (esc(i["name"]), esc(_short(pace.isoformat())), done, n))
498         elif n and (pace - today).days <= 14 and done < n / 2:
499             behind.append('%s paces to %s with %d of %d parts done' % (esc(i["name"]), esc(_short(pace.isoformat())), done, n))
500     if behind:
501         items.append('<li><b>Behind pace:</b> %s.</li>' % "; ".join(behind[:4]))
502     starving = [(gid, n) for gid, n in (ctx.get("nudges") or {}).items() if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("kind") == "starving"]
503     names = {i["id"]: i["name"] for i in inits}
504     for gid, n in starving[:3]:
505         items.append('<li class="starve"><b>Starving:</b> %s <span class="lacts"><button class="mini" data-goto="%s">Open</button>'
506                      '<button class="mini" data-nudge-act="not_now" data-key="%s" data-fact="%s" data-text="%s">Not now</button>'
507                      '<button class="mini" data-look-park="%s" title="to the boneyard, with undo">Park</button></span></li>' % (
508                          esc(n.get("text") or names.get(gid, gid)), esc(gid), esc(n.get("key") or ""), esc(n.get("fact") or ""), esc((n.get("text") or "")[:200]), esc(gid)))
509     first = next(((d, p, i) for d, p, i in dated if d >= today), None)
510     if first:
511         items.append('<li><b>One preparation:</b> the nearest date is %s (%s), due %s &mdash; ready it before the week fills.</li>' % (
512             esc(first[1]["text"][:80]), esc(first[2]["name"]), esc(_short(first[0].isoformat()))))
513     return ('<section class="lookahead" id="lookAhead"><div class="kicker">The look-ahead <span class="k-when">the next seven days, from %s</span></div><ul class="blist">%s</ul>'
514             '<div class="lane-note">The nudges that are not urgent wait here instead of interrupting.</div></section>') % (
515         esc(today.strftime("%A %d %B").replace(" 0", " ")), "".join(items))
516

518 def _lead(ctx):
519     """The brief's lead when a set exists: the head as the High Seat reads it - a part that needs him in an active
520     initiative, else the tiers, else the pick-up while the set runs - with an open to its tile."""
521     return None      # Grok (the W2 trim): the set-first lead went with the Active band; the High Seat's head keeps head_act
522     inits = ctx["initiatives"]
523     working = ctx.get("working") or set()
524     head = _ha.head_act(inits, [], today=ctx["today"])
525     pk = _ha.pick_up(inits, [], working=working, today=ctx["today"])
526     name = (head or {}).get("initiative") or (pk or {}).get("initiative") or ""
527     hit = next((i for i in inits if i["name"] == name), None)
528     goto = (' <button class="goto" data-goto="%s">open</button>' % esc(hit["id"])) if hit else ""
529     return esc(_ha.head_sentence(head, pickup=pk)) + goto

532 def _panel(ctx):
533     """The steward's column (W2b-3, 2026-09-30, his word: the dialogue "should open up and fill the whole open space on
534     the right below the brief, it should be interactive and able for me to follow what is going on, ask, discuss";
535     W2c-3: the cockpit's shape): the brief, then the DIALOGUE filling the rest of the column - the one conversation log
536     of the Campaign's cockpit (the last 40 turns; a turn said from a goal's place carries the goal's chip, which opens
537     the goal), live from the moment the page opens (the script polls the cockpit's own stream), the steward's state at
538     its head - and the composer at the column's foot. A login box, hidden until a read is refused (Grok's read of
539     W2c-3: the refusal is answered on the page he is looking at)."""

541     return (
542         # the brief is gone (John, 2026-10-03: "I don't think that it helps"); the look-ahead takes its place

544         '%s'
545         '<div class="loginbox" id="loginBox" hidden><span class="lb-t">This browser is not logged in to Anchor.</span>'
546         '<input id="loginTok" type="password" placeholder="paste the token here" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">'
547         '<button class="mini" id="loginGo">Log in</button><span class="lb-msg" id="loginMsg"></span></div>'
548         '<section class="composer"><label class="sr" for="say">Tell the steward what to do</label>'
549         '<textarea id="say" rows="2" placeholder="Ask %s, discuss, or tell it what to do &mdash; it runs the %s: move &hellip; to tier 2, add a part to &hellip;, &hellip; by Oct 10"></textarea>'
550         '<div class="comp-row"><span class="hint">Ctrl+Enter sends &middot; the steward answers above as it writes; when it changes the record the board reloads with the receipt</span><button class="send" id="sendBtn">Send</button></div>'
551         '<div class="receipt" id="receipt" hidden><span class="r-mark">&#10003;</span><span id="receiptText"></span> <button class="mini" id="undoBtn" hidden>undo</button></div></section>'
552         '</aside>'
553     ) % (look_ahead(ctx), conversation_view(st["label"], ctx.get("pid") or "", "campaign", "", "the " + mode_name(st)), esc(st["label"]), esc(mode_name(st)))

558 def render_campaign_html(ctx, open_id=None) -> str:
559     st = ctx["steward"]
560     inits = ctx["initiatives"]
561     ctx["n_total"] = len(inits)
562     tiers = {k: sum(1 for i in inits if i["tier"] == k) for k in (1, 2, 3)}
563     n_parts = sum(len(i["parts"]) for i in inits)
564     n_dated = sum(1 for i in inits for p in i["parts"] if p["date"] and not p["broken"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked"))
565     n_needs = sum(len(i["needs"]) for i in inits)
566     live = [i for i in inits if i["status"] not in ("done", "parked")]
567     n_bone = len(inits) - len(live)
568     n_seedy = sum(1 for i in live if i["tier"] not in (1, 2))      # Tier 1 + Tier 2 + seed goals = the goals; the seeds fold keeps its own idea count
569     n_parts = sum(len(i["parts"]) for i in live)
570     n_dated = sum(1 for i in live for p in i["parts"] if p["date"] and not p["broken"] and p["status"] not in ("done", "parked"))
